staticReview.failurePreservation: Eligible frozen Notes hidden-preparation failures only; entry error and failure step already stored before supplementary reads. Original confirmation result, action budget and guards are unchanged. Optional diagnostic guards Throwable, including fallback allocation/attachment failure.
staticReview.boundedness: UiAutomation synchronous launch, stream read and parsing run on a daemon worker. Caller wait deadline is finite; a lingering worker holds the global slot until its finally exits. Timeout/service-timeout stops later commands. Construction/start failures release the slot and carry start/end timestamps. At most 256KiB retained plus one overflow-detection byte read per command; a byte-limited prefix is not parsed.
staticReview.parsing: WMS type is selected from mAttrs and owner/display/package/mClient are checked. Populator visible and grouped presentations are counted separately, full fixed suffixes consumed and malformed/duplicate/extra groups remain unavailable. Final manager header, display context, paired record structure and complete line endings are required. Candidate display/type mismatches remain inconclusive.
staticReview.privacy: Only fixed field names/enums, bounded numeric geometry/regions/transforms, ASCII configured component/token and hashes are serialized; tested titles/names and raw exception messages are excluded.
staticReview.integration: No new platform reads inside the original five-second confirmation preparation. No additional input action, screenshot authority, window refresh, tracing or secure-flag change.

limitations: Synthetic host parser/stub checks are not Android device collection or physical-device acceptance. Collector worker timing tests from the implementation agent are separate evidence and are not counted here.
Fixed AOSP tags establish field origin and expected shape, not byte identity with the actual API36/37 system images.
The three dumps are sequential post-failure observations. Binder text is a candidate, not a strong reference; system_server lifetime and atomicity are not established.

EOF means only stdout ended; this UiAutomation API exposes no process exit code or stderr. Observed missing token counts do not prove upstream absence, a specific filter, hidden pixels or a platform bug.

UiAutomation source calls shell without retaining its own lock, but remote dumps can hold WMS/accessibility locks or outlive the caller and affect later capture/cleanup. The diagnostic bounds its own caller waits, not remote termination or the existing harness operations; the host instrumentation timeout remains the outer test limit.
Under resource exhaustion even allocating the optional fallback can fail; the original Throwable is preserved but a diagnostic marker may be absent.
